CREATE TRIGGER trg_readiness_boards_update AFTER UPDATE ON boards WHEN OLD.settings IS NOT NEW.settings OR OLD.realm_id IS NOT NEW.realm_id BEGIN 
    INSERT OR IGNORE INTO readiness_scope
      (id,realm_id,board_id,spec_id,edition,source_revision,active_generation_id,tombstone,updated_at)
    SELECT s.id || ':' || s.edition,coalesce(b.realm_id,'local'),s.board_id,s.id,s.edition,
      0,NULL,0,strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f','now') FROM specs s JOIN boards b ON b.id = s.board_id WHERE s.board_id = NEW.id;
    UPDATE readiness_scope SET source_revision=source_revision+1,updated_at=strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f','now'),
      realm_id=(SELECT coalesce(realm_id,'local') FROM boards WHERE id=readiness_scope.board_id),
      tombstone=CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM specs active_spec
        WHERE active_spec.id=readiness_scope.spec_id
          AND active_spec.edition=readiness_scope.edition
          AND active_spec.archived=0) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
      WHERE id IN (SELECT s.id || ':' || s.edition FROM specs s JOIN boards b ON b.id = s.board_id WHERE s.board_id = NEW.id);
    INSERT INTO readiness_job
      (scope_id,requested_revision,state,owner,lease_epoch,lease_until,attempt,due_at,error_code,updated_at)
    SELECT id,source_revision,'pending',NULL,0,NULL,0,strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f','now','+0.05 seconds'),NULL,strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f','now')
      FROM readiness_scope WHERE id IN (SELECT s.id || ':' || s.edition FROM specs s JOIN boards b ON b.id = s.board_id WHERE s.board_id = NEW.id)

      requested_revision=max(readiness_job.requested_revision,excluded.requested_revision),
      state=CASE WHEN readiness_job.state='running' THEN 'running' ELSE 'pending' END,
      owner=CASE WHEN readiness_job.state='running' THEN readiness_job.owner ELSE NULL END,

      attempt=CASE WHEN readiness_job.state='running' THEN readiness_job.attempt ELSE 0 END,
